peoples_entry.name: Coyote Men
peoples_entry.note: The Five Hum-Speaking Therian Nations of the SW Outer Rim Outlands (Ham-Hau, Tong-Hau, Si-Hau, Kam-Hau, Lok-Hau; LORE.md S6.18, S10; biomes/outlands/PLAN.md S6; kits/coyote/PLAN.md): canid-headed, brush-furred, tailed therians (`coat: "coyote"`, `mods: ["mod_head_coyote", "mod_tail_coyote"]`) wearing ear-clear `fits_beast` crowns, tail-cleared kilim split-kilts, paw-open stirrups/greaves, cast Outlands bronze, black crater-impactite glass, turquoise mosaic, warrior ostrich plumes, and priest-only roadrunner feathers (strictly zero gold; 12 tiers at 100% M+F parity; tools/garments/cultures/coyote_men.py).
